collectionMethod: Manual capture around 10:38 Beijing time / 02:38Z on 2026-11-18 of the official OpenCode Go documentation page (https://opencode.ai/docs/go/, which 301-redirects to /docs/console/go/), the Go landing page (https://opencode.ai/go, 302-redirects to /console/go), the documentation markdown export (https://opencode.ai/docs/console/go.md), the OpenCode console changelog RSS feed (https://opencode.ai/console/changelog/rss.xml) and the full model catalog endpoint referenced by the documentation (https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/models). All surfaces were compared against the 2026-11-17 captures of the same URLs. The 2026-11-18 documentation HTML prerender is substantially thinner than the 2026-11-17 capture (101791 -> 64821 bytes) and no longer embeds the per-model price / Monthly limit tables; the markdown export likewise does not print a GLM-5.3 $200 figure and points readers to https://opencode.ai/console/go#limits. The landing page and the models API remain the surfaces that publish the new monthly limits. Every price, limit and estimate below is transcribed as published. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed, no chart or site change.
scope: OpenCode Go official models interface only. The change on 2026-11-18 is that the published monthly limit for GLM-5.3 moved from Go $15 / Go Plus $120 / Go Teams $20 to Go $200 / Go Plus $400 / Go Teams $205. The three-part token price is unchanged. GLM-5.3-Flash and every other paid model's monthly_usage in the models API are unchanged. Research-only — not adopted; no computed allowance, no script change, no leaderboard/score data.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; the opencode_go × glm-5.3 adopted row is generated from scripts/build_adopted.py OPENCODE_GO_MODELS (still the previous $15 Go monthly limit); updating it to the new $200 monthly limit is left to maintainer review
